  • Method Details

    • ambientOcclusion

      public @Nullable Float ambientOcclusion()
      If this material has ambient occlusion applied when lighting, shadows will be created around and underneath the block. Decimal value controls exponent applied to a value after lighting. Add-on JSON ambient_occlusion. Optional (null: not set). Range [0, 10] (Bedrock 26.60).
      Returns:
      the value

    • faceDimming

    • isotropic

      @BedrockFormat("1.21.80") public boolean isotropic()
      Should the faces that this material is applied to randomize their UVs? This item requires a format version of at least 1.21.80. Add-on JSON isotropic. Default: false.
      Returns:
      the value

    • tintMethod

      @BedrockFormat("1.21.80") public @Nullable String tintMethod()
      Tint multiplied to the color. Tint method logic varies, but often refers to the "rain" and "temperature" of the biome the block is placed in to compute the tint. Supported tint methods are "none", "default_foliage", "birch_foliage", "evergreen_foliage", "dry_foliage", "grass" and "water" This item requires a format version of at least 1.21.80. Add-on JSON tint_method. Optional (null: not set). The docs give the default false, which is not a value of this type; unset, BDS's behaviour applies.
      Returns:
      the value
